description_en: Binds an advanced office network to a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
description_zh: 将高级办公网络与云企业网实例绑定
kebab_example: aliyun ecd attach-cen --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cen-id cen-3gwy16dojz1m650000 --cen-owner-id 1026819517150000 --verify-code 120000 --office-site-id cn-hangzhou+dir-3633530000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachCen

parameters.description_en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
parameters.description_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to query the most recent region list

parameters.description_en: The ID of the CEN instance.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the CEN instance
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.description_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account to which the CEN instance belongs.

*   If you own the CEN instance, you can skip this parameter.
*   If you do not own the CEN instance, you must specify the ID of the account that owns the CEN instance.
parameters.description_zh:
云企业网实例所属的阿里云账号ID。

- 如果配置的CenId属于本阿里云账号，该参数无需配置。

- 如果配置的CenId属于其他阿里云账号，请填写所属阿里云账号的ID。
